description: Moves eligible emails to another folder in the provider mailbox. Requires threadId and folderId, where folderId is the id of a target in the thread's folder.moveTargets, not a folder name. An optional messageId from that thread moves only that email. Sent and Drafts stay in place and are not move targets. Emails moved outside the watched folders disappear from the inbox; other visible emails keep the conversation available. Returns the folder name and the moved, skipped and failed counts, and reports a provider rate limit or an early stop with its reason.

folderId.description: Id of the target folder, taken from the thread's folder.moveTargets; a folder name is not accepted

messageId.description: Email message id in this thread. Omit to move all eligible emails

threadId.description: Id of the email thread, as listed in the inbox

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: move_email_thread

stoppedReason.description: Error code when the provider stopped the move part way for a reason other than a rate limit

title: Move email thread to a folder
